name: archboard-layout
responsibility: Lays out an architecture picture: one solve of a measured graph by Track or Blocks, and the choice between the solves
description: Its ECMAScript semantics beyond archboard-ecma's arithmetic (ecma.rs) and the few measures of boxes it takes (geometry.rs) are its own; so is the geometry only the layout uses, a route read backwards and route equality at drawn precision (routes/curves.rs, ADR 0091). From archboard-painting it reads only the page margin, the boxes junction marks take, where a card's top runs straight, and a frame's tab width and header padding.
